fields.System.Title: CNT-502 — Count every location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want count tasks for every location in the warehouse, so
that nothing is missed during a full count.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the freeze is active, then a count task exists for every active location,
  • including those the system believes are empty.
  • - Given an empty location, then it must still be counted and confirmed as empty —
  • finding stock there is exactly what a full count is for.
  • - Given progress, then I can see how many locations are counted, outstanding, and in
  • progress.
  • - Given counting, then it is blind, as in [CNT-202](CNT-202-blind-count-entry.md).
  • - Given a location that cannot be counted, then it must be explicitly recorded as
  • skipped with a reason.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | count_task, count_result |
| Risks | Empty locations skipped, so found stock is never discovered |
| Tests | integration |
